name: deployment-safety
description: Upload a version preview, review it, then explicitly promote or roll back a known Worker version.
config: Enable preview_urls explicitly only after reviewing public accessibility.
Do not apply this version-preview workflow to Workers that implement Durable Objects, Containers, or Sandbox.
Set WORKER_ENVIRONMENT when all lifecycle commands should target a named Wrangler environment.
docs: Record the candidate version ID, preview URL, active version before promotion, review result, and rollback target.
Document preview access control and the application-specific smoke checklist.
Document binding, migration, and data compatibility limits for rollback.
notes: Preview upload creates a remote Worker version but does not change active traffic.
Promotion and rollback are explicit remote traffic mutations and require authorization.
Preview URLs are public by default when enabled and do not currently expose Workers logs.
